title: 7日間 Sri Lanka Highlights （4つ星ホテル＆専用車）
seoTitle: 7日間 Sri Lanka Highlights （4つ星ホテル＆専用車） | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Experience Sri Lanka’s highlights in 7日間 culture, tea country, wildlife, and coast with a private Hai Sri Lanka itinerary.
shortDescription: The essential Sri Lanka circuit - culture, wildlife, tea country, and coast with 4 STAR hotels and a private driver.
overview:
A curated seven-day private circuit designed as the essential Sri Lanka experience. Move from Cultural Triangle icons into highland tea estates, then wildlife and a soft coastal finale.
Days are paced for comfort and discovery — private vehicle throughout, thoughtfully chosen stays, and enough time at each stop to feel the island rather than rush past it.

itinerary.title: Arrival & West Coast
itinerary.description: Airport welcome and gentle settle-in near Negombo or Colombo with time to recover from travel.

itinerary.title: Toward the Cultural Triangle
itinerary.description: Journey inland through countryside landscapes toward ancient-city country.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya & Dambulla
itinerary.description: Climb Lion Rock and visit Dambulla Cave Temple with considered pacing and recovery time.

itinerary.title: Kandy
itinerary.description: Continue to the highland capital for the Temple of the Tooth and lakeside atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Tea Country
itinerary.description: Rise into misty tea estates around Nuwara Eliya for tasting and highland air.

itinerary.title: South Coast
itinerary.description: Descend toward the southern shoreline with Galle Fort and beach light.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Leisure morning and private transfer to the airport timed to your flight.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences to your preferences.
